before_action.text: 原有腹壁瘢痕下可能直接贴着肠袢，第一层不要盲目深入。
before_action.text_en: Bowel loops may adhere directly beneath the old abdominal scar. Do not enter the first layer blindly.

before_action.text: 圆刀片、细剪和小吸引头，准备从浅层慢慢进入。
before_action.text_en: Scalpel, fine scissors, and small suction tip, ready for a cautious superficial entry.

after_resolution.text: 切口下面的黏连边缘已经看到了，我维持腹壁上提，避免压住肠壁。
after_resolution.text_en: The adhesion margins beneath the incision are visible. I'll lift the abdominal wall without compressing bowel.

before_action.text: 现有解剖不能照标准腹部地图猜，我先把可见肠段的走行逐段指出。
before_action.text_en: We cannot rely on a standard abdominal map here. I'll trace the visible bowel loops one segment at a time.

before_action.text: 湿纱布和无创肠钳准备好，先做标记，不急着分离。
before_action.text_en: Moist pads and atraumatic bowel graspers are ready. We'll mark structures before dissecting.

after_resolution.text: 残存组织、旧伤和主要黏连区有了对应关系，后面只处理真正相关的部分。
after_resolution.text_en: The remaining tissues, old injuries, and major adhesions are mapped. We'll treat only what is relevant.

after_resolution.text: 复杂旧伤的操作时间不好用单一步骤估计，我持续复核体温与循环。
after_resolution.text_en: The duration of work around old injuries is hard to predict from one step. I'll keep reviewing temperature and circulation.

before_action.text: 这条腹壁黏连直接牵着肠浆膜，先找不伤肠壁的可重复平面。
before_action.text_en: This adhesion pulls directly on bowel serosa. Find a reproducible plane that spares the bowel wall.

before_action.text: 细剪、无创镊和双极，吸引先用低干扰的位置。
before_action.text_en: Fine scissors, atraumatic forceps, and bipolar cautery. Keep suction out of the dissection plane.

after_resolution.text: 释放的肠袢我先托起来，检查表面后再移到安全位置。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll support the released loops, inspect their surfaces, then move them to a protected position.

after_resolution.text: 备用湿垫已经补齐，长时间保护肠壁的用品够用。
after_resolution.text_en: Backup moist pads are replenished. Supplies for prolonged bowel protection are available.

before_action.text: 几条黏连看起来都很严重，但并不是每一条都值得切开。
before_action.text_en: Several adhesions look severe, but not every one should be divided.

before_action.text: 这处牵拉与症状区域相符，另一边暂时没有必要为了好看而松解。
before_action.text_en: This traction matches the symptomatic region. There's no need to release the other side for appearance alone.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的目标范围推进，不为了扩大术野而触碰稳定的残存结构。
after_resolution.text_en: Proceed within the selected target area. Do not disturb stable remaining structures merely to widen the view.

after_resolution.text: 目标区的细分离组继续留台，其他器械暂时收回。
after_resolution.text_en: Keep the fine dissection set for the target area. The other instruments can wait.

before_action.text: 这段肠壁又薄又脆，我把对侧牵拉放松，别用张力代替分离。
before_action.text_en: This bowel wall is thin and fragile. I'll release countertraction; tension is no substitute for dissection.

before_action.text: 精细剪、无创镊和湿润小棉片。
before_action.text_en: Fine scissors, atraumatic forceps, and small moist pledgets.

before_action.text: 先认清浆膜和瘢痕交界，视野不够就继续松开周围空间。
before_action.text_en: Identify where serosa meets scar. If the view is insufficient, release more surrounding space first.

after_resolution.text: 危险黏连已经松开，先检查浆膜连续性，再看有没有局部修补需要。
after_resolution.text_en: The hazardous adhesion is released. Check serosal continuity before deciding whether local repair is needed.

after_resolution.text: 这段需要持续慢操作，我会跟进体温和灌注支持。
after_resolution.text_en: This phase requires sustained careful work. I'll monitor warming and perfusion support.

before_action.text: 这不是标准肠系膜供血分布，先弄清每条侧支真正供应哪段肠管。
before_action.text_en: This is not a standard mesenteric vascular pattern. Trace what each collateral actually supplies.

before_action.text: 细血管环和血管剥离器已经替换到无菌台前排。
before_action.text_en: Fine vessel loops and vascular dissectors are now at the front of the sterile table.

after_resolution.text: 我保护侧支转折的位置，下一步牵拉别把它们拉直了。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll protect the bends in the collateral vessels. Avoid stretching them straight during the next step.

after_resolution.text: 肠道灌注仍是这一段的重点，循环变化会随时反馈。
after_resolution.text_en: Bowel perfusion remains the priority here. I'll report circulatory changes as they occur.

before_action.text: 旧伤段就在深面，我把旁边可用的肠管先隔开。
before_action.text_en: The old injured segment lies deeper. I'll isolate the neighboring viable bowel first.

before_action.text: 无创肠钳、湿纱布和修补用针线先摆出来。
before_action.text_en: Atraumatic bowel graspers, moist pads, and repair sutures are being laid out.

after_resolution.text: 待修复的局部已经清楚，附近未受累的残存组织不要再动。
after_resolution.text_en: The repair target is clear. Leave adjacent unaffected remaining tissues alone.

before_action.text: 缝合边缘必须有足够血供，不能为了整齐把薄弱组织切掉太多。
before_action.text_en: The repair edges need adequate blood supply. Don't remove excess fragile tissue for a neater line.

before_action.text: 细肠线、小持针器和无创镊，按顺序递。
before_action.text_en: Fine bowel sutures, small needle holder, and atraumatic forceps, ready in order.

before_action.text: 我托住修补段的近远端，让你缝合时看见真实张力。
before_action.text_en: I'll support both ends of the repair so you can judge the actual suture tension.

after_resolution.text: 修补附近的肠袢我维持自然位置，避免把缝线拉成绷紧的直线。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll keep neighboring loops in a natural position so the repair line stays free of tension.

after_resolution.text: 已用针线按组清点，下一步血供复核的器械正在替换。
after_resolution.text_en: Used needles and sutures are counted by set. Instruments for vascular reassessment are being exchanged.

before_action.text: 侧支血管沿着这段修补区走，我先让牵开器离开它们。
before_action.text_en: Collateral vessels run beside this repair. I'll move retractors away from them.

before_action.text: 细血管剥离器、湿棉片和双极，先不要上硬钳。
before_action.text_en: Fine vascular dissector, moist pledgets, and bipolar cautery. No rigid clamps yet.

after_resolution.text: 供血路径的压迫点已经处理，回头再看修补段有没有受牵。
after_resolution.text_en: The compression points along the blood supply have been addressed. Recheck tension on the repair.

after_resolution.text: 麻醉侧继续看灌注变化，单凭术野颜色不能替代整体判断。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll continue assessing perfusion changes. Tissue color alone cannot replace the full assessment.

before_action.text: 这一步不是再做一次修补，而是核对连续性、张力和肠管方向。
before_action.text_en: This is not another repair. We're checking continuity, tension, and bowel orientation.

before_action.text: 冲洗液、细无创镊和必要的补针器械都在这里。
before_action.text_en: Irrigation, fine atraumatic forceps, and revision suturing tools are here.

after_resolution.text: 我把肠袢放回自然走行，避免新形成的急弯。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll return the bowel loops to their natural course and avoid creating a sharp kink.

after_resolution.text: 下一步复核要用的冲洗和止血材料已经补到手术间。
after_resolution.text_en: Irrigation and hemostatic materials for the final review are replenished.

before_action.text: 分别复核修补点、侧支血供和可疑渗漏，别把三个检查混成一眼扫过。
before_action.text_en: Review the repair, collateral perfusion, and possible leakage separately. Don't reduce three checks to one glance.

before_action.text: 需要结合术野观察灌注，我会把当前循环趋势及时通报。
before_action.text_en: Perfusion needs correlation with the field. I'll report current hemodynamic trends promptly.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的复核路径完成检查，没有指征的区域不再扩大松解。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete the review along the selected path. Do not extend adhesiolysis into areas without an indication.

after_resolution.text: 使用过的修补线材和止血用品已登记，开始准备最终清点。
after_resolution.text_en: The repair sutures and hemostatic supplies used are logged. Preparing final counts.

before_action.text: 关闭时让肠管自然落回，别把残存血管压在筋膜边缘。
before_action.text_en: Let the bowel settle naturally during closure. Don't trap surviving vessels against the fascial edge.

before_action.text: 筋膜缝线、皮下器械和最终清点单已经准备。
before_action.text_en: Fascial sutures, subcutaneous instruments, and the final count sheet are ready.

after_resolution.text: 纱布、针和器械完成终末核对，术后观察要点随交接单移交。
after_resolution.text_en: Final sponge, needle, and instrument counts are complete. Postoperative priorities accompany the handoff.

after_resolution.text: 复苏团队会重点注意消化道修补与灌注观察，继续接手监测。
after_resolution.text_en: The recovery team will focus on bowel repair and perfusion surveillance as monitoring continues.
